mechanism_narrative: Sustained negative RETAIL_REC across all four weeks (range -14.7 to -22.9) reflects suppressed consumer mobility. The absence of recovery signals continued avoidance behavior that will persist over the next four weeks, keeping RETAIL_REC below baseline.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days by more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains elevated (10.0 to 19.7 percent change) while RETAIL_REC is depressed, indicating consumers are substituting discretionary retail with essential shopping. This substitution pattern will continue if GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated, suppressing RETAIL_REC recovery.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +5 percent change for two consecutive weeks AND RETAIL_REC rises above -10 percent in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has deteriorated from -13.7 to -16.4 percent over the last two weeks, signaling reduced commuting and mobility infrastructure use. Declining transit access constrains retail foot traffic, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT declines more than 2 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -16.4 in t-0w, worst in two weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT recovers to above -10 percent change and RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises above -10 percent within the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility remains suppressed (-10.9 to -19.0 percent) across all four weeks, indicating ongoing workplace restrictions or remote-work adoption. Reduced workplace presence eliminates weekday retail demand from commuters and office workers, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -5 percent change for two consecutive weeks without corresponding RETAIL_REC improvement.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility is severely depressed (-32.4 to -47.3 percent), with worsening trend in t-0w (-47.3). This signals outdoor activity avoidance driven by weather, policy, or disease concerns. Concurrent suppression of discretionary mobility extends to RETAIL_REC, which will remain negative as consumers avoid all non-essential venues.
failure_condition: PARKS recovers to above -30 percent change while RETAIL_REC remains below -15 percent for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated (8.1 to 11.9 percent) across all four weeks, indicating sustained home-based activity. High residential mobility combined with low RETAIL_REC suggests consumers are sheltering in place. If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed as the home-based regime persists.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +5 percent change for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises above -10 percent.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC shows marginal improvement from t-3w (-22.9) to t-1w (-14.7), indicating early recovery momentum. If this upward trend continues, RETAIL_REC will cross into less-negative territory over the next four weeks, producing a positive direction relative to the last 28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC improves by more than 3 percentage points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 8.2 points from t-3w to t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines below -20 percent in any of the next four weeks or shows no net improvement over the 28-day forward period.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both suppressed, but if TRANSIT recovers faster than WORKPLACES, commuters will gain mobility access before workplace demand returns. This creates a window where transit-enabled retail visits increase. RETAIL_REC will rise if TRANSIT improves while WORKPLACES remains constrained.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 5 percentage points while WORKPLACES remains below -10 percent
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -16.4, WORKPLACES at -14.7 in t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES move in lockstep (correlation > 0.8) over the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to rise above -10 percent despite TRANSIT improvement.
